Pre-conditions:
1. User is logged in as Admin
2. Dashboard page is displayed
Test Steps:
1. Open browser and navigate to OrangeHRM login URL
2. Enter valid credentials and click Login
3. Click on 'Admin' tab in the left sidebar menu
Expected Result:
1. Login is successful and Dashboard is displayed
2. Admin module page loads with User Management section visible
3. URL changes to /admin/viewSystemUsers
4. System Users list is displayed with search filters

Pre-conditions:
1. User is logged in as Admin
2. Admin module is open (System Users page)
Test Steps:
1. Click the '+ Add' button on the System Users page
2. Select User Role from dropdown (e.g., 'Admin')
3. Enter Employee Name (start typing and select from autocomplete)
4. Select Status as 'Enabled'
5. Enter a unique Username
6. Enter Password meeting complexity requirements
7. Confirm Password
8. Click 'Save' button
Test Data:
User Role: Admin
Employee Name: (select existing employee)
Status: Enabled
Username: TestUser_Auto
Password: Test@1234
Confirm Password: Test@1234
Expected Result:
1. Add User form is displayed with all required fields
2. All dropdowns populate correctly
3. Employee Name autocomplete works
4. After clicking Save, a success toast message 'Successfully Saved' appears
5. User is redirected back to System Users list
6. Newly created user appears in the list

Pre-conditions:
1. User is logged in as Admin
2. At least one user 'TestUser_Auto' exists in the system
3. Admin > User Management page is open
Test Steps:
1. In the System Users page, locate the search filters
2. Enter the username 'TestUser_Auto' in the Username field
3. Click the 'Search' button
4. Verify the search results display the correct user
Expected Result:
1. Search filters are visible at the top of the page
2. Username field accepts text input
3. After clicking Search, the results table updates
4. Exactly one record is shown matching 'TestUser_Auto'
5. The record shows correct User Role, Employee Name, and Status

3. Admin > User Management page is open

1. Enter 'TestUser_Auto' in the Username search field
2. Click 'Search' button
3. Observe the search results

1. Search completes without errors
2. Results table shows 'No Records Found' message
3. Record count shows 0
